newsitem.title: USA: FirstFederal sees modest EPS boost in buy.
newsitem.headline: FirstFederal sees modest EPS boost in buy.

text.p: FirstFederal Financial Services Corp said Tuesday it completed the acquisition of Summit Bancorp and that it expects a modest earnings accretion from the deal.
FirstFederal issued about 549,000 shares of common stock in exchange for the 235,000 shares of Summit outstanding.
"The transaction is expected to be modestly accretive to FirstFederal earnings per share within its first full year," FirstFederal said.
Additionally, FirstFederal said its First Federal Savings and Loan Association of Wooster subsidiary had completed the acquisition of Alliance Corporate Resources Inc.

The company also said its conversion to a bank holding company and First Federal Savings and Loan Association of Wooster's conversion to a national bank are complete. It said the bank's new name is Signal Bank NA.
